ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var raw = String(result);
var data;
try {
    data = JSON.parse(raw);
} catch (e) {
    var m = raw.match(/dstr\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"/);
    if (m) {
        var step1 = String(java.base64Decode(m[1]));
        var step2;
        try {
            step2 = decodeURIComponent(step1);
        } catch (e2) {
            step2 = step1;
        }
        data = JSON.parse(step2);
    } else {
        data = { chapter_list: [] };
    }
}
var chapters = data.chapter_list || [];
var list = [];
var bookUrl = String(book.bookUrl);
if (bookUrl.charAt(bookUrl.length - 1) !== '/') bookUrl += '/';
for (var i = 0; i < chapters.length; i++) {
    list.push({
        text: chapters[i].name,
        url: bookUrl + chapters[i].file_name,
        info: String(chapters[i].len + '字')
    });
}
list;
</js>
